== Notes ==
* Consider combining with [[Auspicious Incantation]] due to its high energy cost and low recharge.
* [[Angorodon's Gaze]] can help with the energy cost of this skill, while the life stealing it provides can alleviate the health loss from the poison. 
* Consider using [[Plague Signet]], [[Plague Sending]] or [[Plague Touch]] to transfer the Poison condition to your foes.
* [[AI]] will only use this skill on an enchanted foe.

== Trivia ==
* [[w:Chilblains|Chilblains]] is a medical condition similar to frostbite.
